info.title: server API
info.description: Machine-readable API contract for the Express backend in server.

Email.description: Full email including text/html body, returned by the detail route.

preview.description: First 400 characters of the text body, used to render list rows

patternType.description: domain also blocks every subdomain of the pattern

scope.description: domain scope only blocks mail arriving at the linked recipient domain

domain.description: Recipient domain the rule is restricted to, null for global rules
Restrict the rule to a single recipient domain

BlockedSenderMatch.description: Present only when the inbound email was rejected by a blocked sender rule

EmailSummary.description: Trimmed version used for lists; full text/html omitted so the payload does not grow with email count. Call GET /v1/emails/{id} to fetch the full content.

preview.description: First 400 characters of the text body, used to render list rows

delete.description: Global admin only. Cascades to permissions, emails, email registrations.

get.summary: List mailbox registrations for the current user
get.description: Normal users only see their own registrations. Global admins may pass ownerUserId to inspect another user.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on recipient_address; also narrows total.

post.description: Mailbox must still be covered by the caller's permission scope. Each mailbox can only be registered by one user globally. Re-registering the same mailbox by the same user is idempotent.

get.summary: Generate and register a realistic new mailbox
get.description: Creates a realistic-looking mailbox address on an active domain available to the caller, then registers it immediately. Normal users are limited to domains where they have active permission. Global admins may use any active domain and may optionally target another owner with ownerUserId. This route accepts bearer session tokens and API keys.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Optional active domain to force mailbox generation onto. The caller must be allowed to use it; global admins may use any active domain.

parameters.name: ownerUserId
parameters.description: Optional owner override for global admins.

delete.description: Owners may delete their own registration. Global admins may delete any registration.

get.description: Global admins can list all emails with scope=system. Any caller can force scope=registered to only see emails whose mailbox is both permitted and registered in email_registers for that user. domain/address/search filters narrow the result set. search supports multiple terms and checks subject, body, stored metadata and raw_mime when available.

400.description: Bad query or missing scope filters

post.description: Deletes up to 200 emails in one request. Normal users must have write access to each selected email. The response includes deletedIds as well as missingIds and deniedIds so clients can reconcile stale selections.

get.description: Normal users can only read emails whose mailbox is registered for them and still covered by permission. Global admins can read any email.

delete.description: Normal users must have domain permission for the mailbox domain and the mailbox must be registered for them.

get.description: Path emailAddress must be URL-encoded. Normal users must have domain permission for the mailbox domain and a matching email_registers entry.

schema.description: Unix timestamp. Seconds and milliseconds are both accepted; only emails after this time are returned

delete.summary: Delete all emails in a mailbox
delete.description: Path emailAddress must be URL-encoded. Normal users must have domain permission for the mailbox domain and a matching mailbox registration.

post.summary: Ingest raw MIME email from worker

202.description: Email accepted; blocked senders are acknowledged but discarded

id.description: null when the email was blocked and therefore not stored

blocked.description: true when a blocked sender rule discarded the email

get.description: Global admin only. Returns current database file sizes and the total size of the SQLite storage folder.

post.description: Global admin only. Deletes emails older than olderThanDays, optionally scoped to one domain. Supports dryRun preview mode and batch limits. Real prune runs also checkpoint WAL and VACUUM the database.

get.summary: Get Telegram system settings and runtime

502.description: Telegram settings saved but runtime reload failed

post.description: Public webhook route. Requires the X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header to match the configured webhook secret.

409.description: Sender already blocked for the requested scope
